edge_sample.source_text: definition Alphabet Size: The alphabet size is $q := \lvert\alpha\rvert$, the cardinality of the finite alphabet $\alpha$.
edge_sample.target_text: definition Maximal With Respect to Inclusion: Let $C\subseteq \Sigma^{n}$ with minimum distance denoted $\Delta(C)$. $C$ is defined to be maximal with respect to inclusion if: \[\forall C' \subseteq \Sigma^{n}, C\subseteq C', \Delta(C) = \Delta(C') \implies C'\subseteq C\]
